product_intent.summary: Keep ST Student App small, read-only, accessible and offline-capable for teacher-approved SesliTab practice packages. STUDENT-07B adds bounded student playback without moving teacher authority, OMR, editing or canonical-source mutation into the Student App.
authority_chain: IndexedDB private offline Practice Package cache

required_skills: superpowers:systematic-debugging when any test or runtime behavior is unexpected
superpowers_execution.method: Native/TDD continuation on the existing feature branch; do not restart completed tasks.

architecture_invariants.canonical_events_timing: Never infer playback timing from content.canonicalEvents.

qualities.FULL: Only a validated plan from an explicitly trusted timing provider may be labeled FULL.
qualities.APPROXIMATE: Supported score-partwise MusicXML compiles to a bounded approximate PlaybackPlan. This is the default route.

piano_bank.meaning: 12 local samples represent the 12 chromatic pitch classes C through B, not a 12-voice polyphony limit.
piano_bank.timbre_policy: Every part/voice uses the same piano sound family for STUDENT-07B.

architecture_invariants.playback_failure_isolation: Playback, tempo and measure-repeat errors remain capability-local and must not disable notation or expose raw provider/XML detail.
architecture_invariants.storage: Private Practice Packages remain IndexedDB-owned. Cache Storage is static shell/runtime only.
architecture_invariants.rendering_layer: ST Score Rendering Layer remains notation presentation authority only; no cross-repo source change is authorized by this handoff.
